## Series 01

#load libraries

```{r load-libraries}
#load the necesary libraries for data manipulation and visualize

```

```{r}

students <- read.csv("data/IEAP-2025 - Sheet1.csv")
```

```{r table}
#knitr::kable(students)

```

